timing_honesty.our_words: Per-fetch UTC timestamps were NOT captured at each call — neither fetch tool returns one. Three wall-clock readings anchor the window: 2026-09-02T12:14:35Z (read inside the browser during the web.dev fetch), 12:18:02Z and 12:18:56Z (bash date -u). All fetches below fall between roughly 12:00Z and 12:18Z on 2026-09-02.
timing_honesty.consequence: Times are given as the anchored window, not as invented per-call stamps. Where a real timestamp exists it is quoted.

bytes_honesty.our_words: mcp__workspace__web_fetch returns rendered text and does NOT report a byte count or an HTTP status code. For those rows 'http' records what the tool's behaviour DEMONSTRATES (content returned = a successful response; empty body = recorded as such) rather than a status line this lane actually saw. Where a real size was measured in the browser, it is given as a character count with the method named.
bytes_honesty.cross_ref: measure-dont-convert-units — a count is not a measurement; the unit is named on every figure below.
